data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘travus’, meaning ‘a traveler’. This name was popular among ancient Romans and early Christians, symbolizing a journey towards spiritual growth and enlightenment. The name Travus carries the meaning “Traveler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Travus usually hope their child will grow to embody traveler and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Τραυσος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'traos', meaning 'strong', 'robust'. The name Travus in Greek could mean 'strong'.

in_latin.name: Travus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'travus', derived from 'treo', meaning 'to hold, to support'. The name Travus in Latin could mean 'strength', 'power'.

in_english.name: Travus
in_english.long_meaning: The name Travus in English could mean 'strength', 'power'. It could also be derived from the Old English word 'trave', meaning 'a journey'.
